title: One boss at every stage: the Dark Librarian
body: Every capture from 524 to 746 shows the same Librarian, Dark, weak to Light. No dungeon rotates by weekday.

title: Two opening pushes; enter at 47–48 s
body: A first slam near 53 s, a double push ending about 48 s. Manual players enter right after it; walking in early gets the team hit again.

title: Later hits near 38 s; re-entry about 32 s
body: A commenter times another hit at 38 s; one manual guide re-enters at 32 s after pulling out.

title: Pushes every few seconds shove the team out of the book ring
body: The team heals safely outside the books, then re-enters. Knockback resistance helps: Princess Bari, the Little Ghost pet.

title: Flying book rows do the damage
body: A book hit leaves Milk standing still. Manual players park in the gap between book rows.

title: Milk, Brightseeker or Pomegranate dying loses the run
body: Auto works because Milk and the shields absorb the opening; then Brightseeker gets two or more skill casts.

title: Low power caps damage
body: At a 35% damage correction (power far under recommended) the auto deck stops working.

title: Retry is the method
body: Every auto source says to keep pressing retry: losses come from the opening, and a rerun with the same deck often clears.

title: Disputed: one EXP dealer or more
body: The 724 and 746 decks run Brightseeker alone; VART and 누리머 add Rye; one poster argues extra dealers clear better.

title: Disputed: does EXP auto hold past 720
body: 746 cleared with no input; others stall at 746 with more power, call the deck a one-day fix, or say 720 needs control.

title: Disputed: the EXP gear preset
body: Conquest (damage-reduction) preset is steadier per several posts; others need the stage preset's damage; some use arena plus Rooty for accuracy.

title: Projectile Speed pet tipped the EXP deck
body: Furball Pup adds Projectile Speed synergy and ATK; the 746 poster calls it the key.

title: Armor Repair in nearly every EXP deck
body: Three or more tanks give allies 10% damage reduction; Hound, Ion and Moon Rabbit are there for it.

title: Disputed: the second perk
body: Health Insurance (+5% max HP with two supports) or Passion Pay (+20% ATK on the top-ATK ally, −20% its HP). 아포 says switch to HP if cookies die entering at 48 s.

title: Other dungeons favour damage perks
body: Passion Pay with Rapid Promotion or Like A Family; one guide keeps Health Insurance plus Armor Repair for EXP only.

title: Scarabs keep their distance
body: They back off when approached and close in when the team holds still. Sit in a corner and let them bunch.

title: Hold 7 o'clock until about 42 s
body: Or release at 50 s. Near the cap the corner stops working; the 770 clears steer from 1 o'clock or circle the corridor.

title: Frogs shoot hard; fight from the 5 o'clock corner
body: Runs fail when cookies die first. 5 o'clock is now preferred over 7.

title: Cream Puff's field launches the frogs
body: Frogs bounce in its field. At about 30% skill haste, with Milk and pet duration, the field never drops.

title: Jellies spawn under the team and explode
body: They keep dropping in until about 40% remain; an explosion can wipe the team. Long fights risk the timer.

title: Opening knock-up: cast Pinot Noir first
body: The golem's first attack launches the team into the air.

title: Green orbs at 53, 45, 37 and 29 s
body: Eight seconds apart; manual players dodge them on those beats.

title: Keys: 3 a day, up to 6
body: Blessing (축복), the permanent ₩5.5k pass and the Crumble Pass add keys; Saturdays and Sundays add more.

title: More keys: shops and packs
body: The mileage and arena shops sell keys, and a ₩6,000 key pack exists. Bought keys stack above the cap.

title: Unknown: does a lost run return its key
body: No capture states it. Guides treat losses as free retries, which suggests a key is spent only on a clear.

title: Sweep (소탕) once stuck
body: Each stage pays a one-time first-clear reward, so players push before sweeping, then sweep at their wall.
